question:
Which of the following organ is part of central nervous system in humans?

I. Heart

II. Spinal cord
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **central nervous system (CNS)** in humans comprises the **brain** and the **spinal cord**.
 
• The **spinal cord** is a crucial part of the CNS, functioning as the communication highway between the brain and the rest of the body. It transmits motor commands from the brain and sensory information from the body.
 
• The **heart**, while vital for pumping blood throughout the body, is part of the circulatory system and not the CNS. Hence, it is not involved in neural processing or control.
 
• The **spinal cord** is responsible for reflex actions and plays a role in the autonomic and voluntary control of movements.
